title: Weather and Seasons
intro: [excited] Welcome in to the forecast for Disney Jeopardy! Today's outlook calls for scattered trivia, heavy snowfall of fun facts, and a one hundred percent chance... [chuckles] of me making weather puns. Let's check the radar!

art.prompt: A magical storybook valley split into four seasons: snowy pine forest on one side, spring blossoms, a sunny summer meadow and golden autumn trees, with a rainbow arching over a fairy-tale castle and a gentle rain cloud drifting above, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Frozen Forecast
categories.intro: We kick things off with a film that turned summer into eternal winter. [dramatic pause] Bundle up... it's FROZEN!

art.prompt: A frozen Nordic fjord kingdom at twilight, an ice palace of glowing blue crystal on a mountain, snow swirling in sparkling spirals, northern lights dancing overhead, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This snowman loves warm hugs and dreams of summer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! The only snowman in history whose life goal is to stand next to a campfire. [laughs]

clues.clue: Anna and Elsa are the royal sisters of this kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Arendelle. Great fjords, lovely castle, occasional surprise blizzard in July.

clues.clue: This trading post owner offers a big summer blowout, plus a sauna, to Anna and Kristoff.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oaken, of Wandering Oaken's Trading Post. [chuckles] Hoo hoo! Don't forget to visit the sauna on your way out.

clues.clue: Hans tells Anna he has this many older brothers.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is twelve! Three of them pretended he was invisible for two years. [mischievously] Honestly... they may have been onto something.

clues.clue: In this 2015 short, every sneeze Elsa lets out during Anna's birthday creates tiny snowmen called snowgies.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen Fever! [laughs] A cold that literally makes more cold. Somebody get that queen some soup.

categories.title: Rain or Shine
categories.intro: Next up, the weather report! Every clue in this category is about wild weather in Disney films. [whispers] Pack an umbrella.

art.prompt: A whimsical sky full of weather: a fluffy storm cloud with lightning, warm sun rays bursting through, wind-blown autumn leaves, falling snowflakes and a kite tumbling through the air over a hand-painted forest, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day, this kind of weather lifts Piglet into the air like a kite.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is wind! Happy WINDS-day, everybody! [laughs] Poor Piglet. Very small animal, very big breeze.

clues.clue: Mulan buries most of the Hun army under this snowy disaster by firing a rocket at a mountainside.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an avalanche. One rocket, one mountain, one VERY bad day for Shan Yu.

clues.clue: In Bambi, the forest animals take cover during this song about a spring rainstorm.
choices: Rain, Rain, Rain Came Down Down Down
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Little April Shower. [sighs] Drip, drip, drop! Easily the most relaxing thunderstorm ever put on film.

clues.clue: In Fantasia, fairies paint autumn leaves and skate frost across a pond in this segment set to Tchaikovsky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Nutcracker Suite! [chuckles] Funny thing, there is no actual nutcracker in it. Just fairies doing the seasons' paperwork.

clues.clue: In this 2009 Pixar short, a gloomy gray cloud named Gus sculpts dangerous babies for his stork partner, Peck.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Partly Cloudy! Gus makes crocodiles, porcupines and rams. Peck deserves hazard pay... and a HELMET.

categories.title: Emoji Forecast
categories.intro: Time for the media category! I'll show you a string of weather-ish emoji and a hint. You name the Disney or Pixar title.

art.prompt: A playful cartoon weather map of a fantasy island world with glossy bubbly icons of suns, clouds, rainbows, umbrellas, snowflakes and a tiny volcano scattered across it, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: 🎈🎈🏠☁️  Hint: a house takes to the sky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up! Ten thousand balloons and one very grumpy homeowner. [gasps] Squirrel!

clues.clue: 🌊⛵🌀🌺  Hint: the ocean chooses a voyager.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! Storms, a coconut pirate fleet and a demigod with a giant ego. [sarcastic] Just another day at sea.

clues.clue: 🐉💧🌧️⚔️  Hint: the last of her kind is a water dragon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raya and the Last Dragon! Sisu brings the rain... [laughs] and also a LOT of jokes.

clues.clue: 🌋❤️🌋🎶  Hint: a lonely singing Pixar short.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lava! A volcano sings for love for a few million years. [sighs] Talk about a long-distance relationship.

clues.clue: 🌧️☂️💙❤️☂️  Hint: two umbrellas fall for each other on a rainy city street.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Blue Umbrella! The 2013 Pixar short where even the gutters and mailboxes have faces. [whispers] Rainy days were never so romantic.

categories.title: Water Park Weather
categories.intro: Our Parks category is all about stormy, snowy, lightning-struck spots in the Disney parks. [mischievously] Watch out for falling shrimp boats.

art.prompt: A tropical water park after a storm: a snow-capped mountain with a ski jump turned waterslide, a shrimp boat perched on a volcanic peak, a huge wave pool and palm trees under clearing skies, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Walt Disney World water park's legend says a freak snowstorm built a Florida ski resort that quickly melted.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Blizzard Beach! A ski resort in Florida. What could possibly go wrong? [laughs] Answer: everything melted.

clues.clue: At the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror, the Hollywood Tower Hotel's guests vanished one stormy 1939 night after the building was struck by this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is lightning! Halloween night, 1939. [whispers] Housekeeping still has not found those five guests.

clues.clue: At Blizzard Beach, this 120-foot speed slide drops you off the top of Mount Gushmore.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Summit Plummet! [gasps] 120 feet STRAIGHT down. Pro tip: cross your ankles, hold on tight, and maybe scream a little.

clues.clue: At Typhoon Lagoon, the shrimp boat Miss Tilly sits stuck on top of this volcanic peak after a storm swept it there.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mount Mayday! Listen for Miss Tilly's whistle, it means a fresh set of big waves is rolling into the surf pool.

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach's ski-loving, sunglasses-wearing alligator mascot goes by this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ice Gator! He loved the melting ski slopes so much he took up water skiing. [chuckles] True Florida spirit.

categories.title: Sing in the Rain
categories.intro: Finally, the fan pick! It's Finish the Lyric, weather edition. I'll give you a line from a stormy, snowy or windy Disney song. [excited] You fill in the blank.

art.prompt: Musical notes made of raindrops and snowflakes swirling around an old-fashioned microphone on a puddle-covered stage, a colorful umbrella and a kite floating above, soft spotlight, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Frozen: Let it go, let it go! The cold never bothered me ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is anyway! [laughs] And if you didn't sing that out loud just now... you're lying.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Mary Poppins: Let's go fly a kite, up to the ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the highest height! Thanks to Mr. Banks, who finally learned that wind is more fun than banking.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Frozen: Do you want to build a snowman? Or ride our bike around the ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is halls! Then she talks to the pictures on the walls. [sighs] Hang in there, Joan.

clues.clue: Finish Olaf's lyric: Bees'll buzz, kids'll blow dandelion fuzz, and I'll be doing whatever snow does in ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is summer! [mischievously] Spoiler alert for Olaf: snow in summer does exactly one thing, and it's called a puddle.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day: The rain, rain, rain came down, down, down, in rushing, rising ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is rivulets! Till the river crept out of its bed and right into Piglet's. A Sherman Brothers CLASSIC.
